macroFacts.label: Youth jobless rate (ages 15-24)
macroFacts.topicAngle: Young people in India finish college and still cannot find steady work
macroFacts.effect: Millions spend years preparing for clerk exams or take low-pay gig delivery work instead of building careers.

macroFacts.label: Workers stuck in farming
macroFacts.topicAngle: Too many Indian workers still depend on small farms that barely pay
macroFacts.effect: Families stay trapped in low earnings and crop debt because factories do not create enough steady jobs.

macroFacts.label: Health bills paid straight from family pockets
macroFacts.topicAngle: One hospital trip can wipe out years of savings for an Indian family
macroFacts.effect: Because public clinics lack doctors and tests, families pay almost half of all medical costs themselves or borrow cash.

macroFacts.label: Total health spending share of GDP
macroFacts.topicAngle: India spends too little on public clinics while private hospital prices surge
macroFacts.effect: Overcrowded government wards push ordinary people into costly private hospitals they cannot afford.

macroFacts.label: Adult women in the paid workforce
macroFacts.topicAngle: Most Indian women are locked out of paid jobs
macroFacts.effect: Unsafe travel, lack of childcare, and fewer safe jobs mean most homes rely on just one paycheck.

macroFacts.label: Average yearly income output per person
macroFacts.topicAngle: Headline growth numbers hide how little the average Indian actually earns
macroFacts.effect: While total national output looks huge, average income per person stays low so rising food and rent squeeze homes.

macroFacts.label: Electricity still coming from coal
macroFacts.topicAngle: India still burns coal for most of its daily electricity
macroFacts.effect: Coal smoke worsens city air, heats up towns, and exposes power grids to blackouts during extreme summer heat.

macroFacts.label: Government spending on schools and colleges
macroFacts.topicAngle: Weak public schools force Indian parents into expensive private tuition
macroFacts.effect: Parents spend hard-earned money on coaching centers just so kids can pass basic tests.

macroFacts.label: Formal bank credit to private businesses
macroFacts.topicAngle: Small shops in India still struggle to get fair bank loans
macroFacts.effect: Even with fast phone payments, local shop owners often pay steep informal interest just to buy daily stock.

macroFacts.label: Fresh water pulled strictly for farming crops
macroFacts.topicAngle: India sends over 90% of its fresh water to crops while big cities buy water tankers
macroFacts.effect: Free farm power pumps groundwater dry for exported rice and sugar, leaving under 10% for city taps, homes, and factories.

macroFacts.label: Central tax money eaten just by old loan interest
macroFacts.topicAngle: Over one-third of India federal tax cash vanishes paying only old debt interest
macroFacts.effect: Before a single rupee pays for schools, trains, or clinics, lenders take 34% of federal taxes while regular people pay steep daily fuel and food taxes.

macroFacts.label: Workers in unstable jobs without written contracts
macroFacts.topicAngle: Over 71% of Indian workers hold zero steady contracts, sick leave, or pension safety
macroFacts.effect: Behind big tech headlines, seven in ten Indians lose income overnight if sickness hits or work slows down.

macroFacts.label: Young children under age 5 stunted from poor nutrition
macroFacts.topicAngle: Over 35% of young Indian kids grow stunted even while India exports millions of tons of grain
macroFacts.effect: Lack of protein, eggs, and clean water hurts early brain and body growth for one in three kids, locking in lower adult earnings.

macroFacts.label: Hospital beds available per 1,000 people
macroFacts.topicAngle: India has roughly 1.6 hospital beds per 1,000 people despite booming private clinic ads
macroFacts.effect: Severe bed shortages force families out of packed public wards into high-cost private clinics that wipe out home savings.
